registration.accuracyStatus: Street-network and satellite spot checks passed; facade-level accuracy has not been measured.
registration.axisConvention: Browser positions use Rhino (X, Z, -Y). Near this fit, +X is east and -Z is north.
registration.formula: EN = scale * R(angleDeg) * [modelX, zSign * modelZ] + [translationEast, translationNorth]

validation.method: OSM street samples against CAD block occupancy; entire OSM ways held out by id modulo 5
validation.warning: Block penetration is a street-consistency proxy, not a building-position or photo-reprojection error.

supersedes.reason: The prior transform omitted the north/south reflection required by the browser coordinate frame.

registration.fitProxyCaveat: Road/block and satellite overlays verify placement proxies; they do not establish per-building positional accuracy.
registration.displayGuidance: Treat a street name as nearby; use the nearest road label only within 150 metres.
